title: HardProof
description: HardProof let's you check whether you have cheated on selected world or not. Very useful while trying to convince your friends that your world is pure survival
body:
# HardProof  'em!

This mod let's you check for inappropriate activity on your selected minecraft world, its mainly purpose is to show your friends that you've never cheated on some worlds if they dont trust you enough.

### - Here are some more specified details:
- Mod checks for:
- Open to lan cheats
- op privilages
- gamemode other than 0
- restoring a world after dying via backups (useful while playing hardcore) [beta]
- cheat clients [feature not yet fully implemented; may not work in most cases]
###  > Performance: [tested on i7-9750H and gtx 1660ti]
###    

| FPS [Avg]          | With HardProof               | Without HardProof            |
|---------------------|:---------------------:|---------------------:|
| Fabric           | 53             | 54          |
| Fabric + sodium           | 98              | 100           |
| Fabric + performium modpack*            | 130             | 130            |

*[Performium](https://modrinth.com/modpack/performium-was-taken) is a great modpack that optimizes your game made by [KasaiSora](https://modrinth.com/user/KasaiSora)
